Report written to `homework-4.4/run-retry-20260925_124416/workers/TASK-12.md`.

Summary: `UpdateArticleParam` has zero Bean Validation annotations, while `NewArticleParam`'s equivalent fields carry `@NotBlank` and `title` also carries `@DuplicatedArticleConstraint`. This asymmetry is intentional, not a gap:

- `Article.update()` (Article.java:51-65) treats blank title/body/description as "no change" — partial-update semantics — so `@NotBlank` genuinely can't apply to the update DTO the way it does on create.
- The title-duplication check isn't dropped for updates — it's preserved via a method-level cross-parameter validator (`ArticleCommandService.java:31`, `DuplicatedArticleUpdateValidator.java`), which is exactly the pattern CLAUDE.md's Conventions section documents as the correct way to avoid the `<cross-parameter>` propertyPath pitfall.
- The same defaulted-blank-fields-drop-`@NotBlank` convention appears in `UpdateUserParam.java`, confirming this is a deliberate codebase-wide pattern, not a one-off oversight.

Only soft recommendation: add `@Valid` to `ArticleApi.java:47`'s `@RequestBody UpdateArticleParam` — currently a no-op, but would prevent future field-level constraints from silently not firing.
